A little clarity
about privacy.

This page explains this website and summarizes the Android app. The full app privacy policy is available in the official repository and offline in Settings → About Aroha Music.

This website

The website has no advertising scripts, analytics trackers, account system, cookies or local-storage tracking. Fonts, real app screenshots and other images are served with the website. This website does not stream or play music.

Our hosting provider processes requests to deliver the site and may keep operational logs, such as IP addresses and browser information. The private preview may require the hosting provider’s sign-in. Download links and GitHub links take you to GitHub, whose privacy practices apply there. Email links open your email app; this website does not collect or store your messages.

The Android app

Listening history, Library Insights and app-health counts stay on the device. Aroha does not require an account. Account login and cloud sync are not implemented.

Standard app builds contain no Firebase SDK. Optional Firebase builds enable basic usage reporting by default and provide a separate, default-off crash-reporting switch. Check your build and settings for the available controls.

Music, lyric and artwork providers receive network requests as part of normal app use. GitHub is used for update checks and APK delivery. Source availability and content restrictions apply.

Your controls

You can manage listening-history recording in the app, use the available reporting switches in Firebase builds and manage app data through Android settings. See the full policy for details about permissions, backups and external services.
